title: Start-up of Couette flow by a moving wall (transient, analytic)
description:
A liquid at rest in a periodic channel; at t = 0 the upper wall (y_hi) starts sliding at U_wall along +x, the lower wall stays fixed (transient laminar flow, no body force). Momentum diffuses in from the moving wall.
Analytic, two equivalent forms: Fourier series u(y, t) = U y / H + (2 U / pi) sum_n (-1)^n sin(n pi y / H) exp(-n^2 t / tau_v) / n, tau_v = H^2 / (pi^2 nu) (fast at late times), and the image series u / U = sum_m [erfc(((2m+1) H - y) / (2 sqrt(nu t))) - erfc(((2m+1) H + y) / (2 sqrt(nu t)))] (fast at early times, m = 0..2 exact to ~1e-12 up to t_end); at the centre u_c(t) = U / 2 - (2 U / pi) sum_odd n (-1)^((n-1)/2) exp(-n^2 t / tau_v) / n.
Probes tab: centre probe u_x(t) with the dashed image series u_centre_exact (the delayed start while momentum diffuses to the centre) and the steady value u_steady = U / 2.
Line profile tab: u_profile_tau (snapshot 1, t = tau_v) and u_profile_end (final state, t_end = 3 tau_v, still 3 % of U from linear at the centre).
Derived values tab: u_c_tau (t = tau_v, 0.266 U) and u_c_end (last sample, 0.468 U) against the Fourier series.
Expected agreement: a few 1e-3 of U (lattice diffusion of the lowest mode ~(pi dx / H)^2 / 12 = 2e-3 of its decay rate, the impulsive wall start resolved in one lattice step); tolerances 1 % (u_c_tau, curves) and 0.5 % (u_c_end), to be confirmed by the first run. The steady answer misses u_c_end by 6 %.

parameters.name: mu_f
parameters.description: dynamic viscosity of the liquid in Pa s

parameters.name: H_ch
parameters.description: wall gap (odd cell count: the centreline is a cell centre)

parameters.name: L_ch
parameters.description: length of the periodic cell along x (the flow is uniform in x)

parameters.name: U_wall
parameters.description: speed of the upper wall along +x in m/s from t = 0

parameters.name: tau_v
parameters.description: decay time of the slowest viscous mode in s (~4.5e-5)

parameters.name: u_c_tau_ref
parameters.description: analytic centre speed at t = tau_v in m/s

parameters.name: u_c_end_ref
parameters.description: analytic centre speed at t_end in m/s

analytic_curves.name: u_centre_exact
analytic_curves.expression: U_wall*(erfc(0.5*H_ch/(2*sqrt(nu_f*t) + 1e-30)) - erfc(1.5*H_ch/(2*sqrt(nu_f*t) + 1e-30)) + erfc(2.5*H_ch/(2*sqrt(nu_f*t) + 1e-30)) - erfc(3.5*H_ch/(2*sqrt(nu_f*t) + 1e-30)) + erfc(4.5*H_ch/(2*sqrt(nu_f*t) + 1e-30)) - erfc(5.5*H_ch/(2*sqrt(nu_f*t) + 1e-30)))
